title: Every reduced separated Noetherian scheme of dimension one admits an ample line bundle
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: Ample bundles on the irreducible components must be glued compatibly near all component intersections. The proof constructs a common affine section neighbourhood of those intersections, then uses conductor ideals and products of component sections to produce affine principal neighbourhoods at every remaining point.
